name: print-social-fintech-story-cards-pastel-blue
title: Three soft pastel story cards for a fintech app
whatItIs: Three tall rounded story cards with progress bars at the top and brand header. One has a person with headphones against clouds, one a blurred gradient credit card, one a glass orb with a dollar sign. Each has a two-line headline and app store badges.
whatItMeans: Airy and reassuring; soft skies and glass objects communicate calm control of money.
techniques: Use a soft sky-blue gradient across all cards.
Pair one photographic card with two 3D or glass object cards.
Add story progress bars to sell the format.
Keep headlines short two-liners with contrasting statements.

vocabulary.definition: Thin bars at the top showing story position.
A translucent sphere with a symbol inside.
App Store and Google Play buttons.
